scope: Prepare future custodian evolution tests; no new evolution, live changes or reserved-gate release.

provenance.source: Development aggregate and separate compatibility review only; reserved cases/answers are excluded.

compatibilityFailures.interpretation: One related source lineage, not ten independent production incidents.

journalCompoundScore.cause: Not isolated for successful maintenance; inspect context persistence is confirmed in finalist.

ordering: Candidate deterministic contract and host envelope
Bounded local worker effects and persisted evidence
Eligible paired model quality with predeclared component constraints
Frozen finalist compatibility review, then one-way reserved gates
priorityNote: Priority denotes release importance, not execution cost. Model quality may be mandatory but is evaluated only after cheap candidate checks pass.

tests.evidence: 10/10 related candidates omit validationCommands/equivalent; baseline consumer passes.
tests.assertion: Existing consumers still observe the complete authorized check capability with preserved types and unknowns; adding execution receipts is compatible.
tests.controls: Baseline and additive-compatible positive; omitted or empty substituted capability negative.
tests.action: Implement as a required pre-model eligibility check in the next trusted verifier/precheck.

tests.evidence: Finalist serializes 245,997 bytes versus baseline 119,566 under the existing 200,000-byte limit; rename source is lost in both status representations.
tests.assertion: Final tool transport fits actual encoded-byte limits; rename/copy retains source and destination or explicitly marks incomplete scope. Include Unicode, long paths and count boundaries.
tests.controls: Bounded complete/additively compatible response positive; oversized or scope-dropping response negative.
tests.action: Measure real serialization and old consumer behavior; do not grade only helper field presence.

tests.evidence: Frozen source/permissions and actual disposable worker hard cases pass; scanner-removal negative control is rejected.
tests.assertion: Retain scanner, repository boundaries, exclusions, staging/mutation rules, exact source preimages and inactive proposals.
tests.controls: Known compatible baseline positive; targeted unsafe mutation negative.
tests.action: Retain meaningful controls without counting inherited utility flags as independent safety cases.

tests.evidence: 5/10 observed decision deltas are negative while all composite deltas are positive; selected pair has zero decision gain.
tests.assertion: Report task quality and receipt utility separately. A receipt gain cannot compensate for a violation of the declared task-quality requirement.
tests.controls: A candidate with known worse task outcomes but richer metadata must not qualify as a task-quality improvement.
tests.action: Freeze component constraints, minimum relevant benefit, sampling budget and incomplete-comparison policy before the next study; do not reuse old scores as new passes.

tests.evidence: The compound successful-maintenance journal criterion scores zero in all ten; finalist inspect journal does retain branch/upstream/changes.
tests.assertion: Successful actual attempts and outcomes have matching safe returned/persisted records, diagnosed by action and field without raw command/environment exports.
tests.controls: Correct persisted receipt positive; correct return but missing persisted observation negative.
tests.action: Split diagnostics while retaining meaningful requirements; isolate the failing subcondition before proposing a repair.

tests.evidence: Private real commit then failed local fetch changes HEAD; blocked result/journal omit before/after identities.
tests.assertion: Report observed partial state, preserve the blocked outcome, never invent remote verification, and do not blindly replay effects.
tests.controls: Bounded local failure after mutation plus a failure before mutation.
tests.action: Test the new provenance goal; distinguish absent new receipts from removal of an old API.

tests.evidence: No-op utility passes in eight of ten candidates; full timeout/unavailable cases were not established by the closed study.
tests.assertion: Noop does not claim a new push or invented checks. Distinguish configured/not-run, attempted/passed, failed, timeout and unavailable using actual observations.
tests.controls: Clean no-op and successful command positives; false passed/remote-success claims negatives.
tests.action: Retain working no-op cases and add missing validation-state families before claiming that coverage.

tests.evidence: Two pre-search native path-length failures precede a working short-root preflight; case-sensitive environment projection was corrected.
tests.assertion: Private fixture roots, child environment and model/dependency readiness work without global configuration changes or live Git effects.
tests.controls: A bounded dry readiness run and retained failing environment/path probes.
tests.action: Run once before paid search; classify setup failure separately from candidate quality.

tests.evidence: The closed model batches consumed fixed scenario observations; worker fixtures ran separately. They did not prove that the model could consume the changed worker's actual output.
tests.assertion: Use actual baseline/candidate tool observations through the existing bounded consumer/adapter for a later task-quality comparison; do not resupply facts missing from the tool in synthetic model inputs.
tests.controls: Compatible actual tool output positive; removed or incomplete capability evidence must remain missing to the consumer rather than being repaired by the evaluator.
tests.action: Run only after cheap eligibility passes, using disposable task inputs and no live publication. Report this integration path separately from fixed-scenario decision fidelity.

tests.evidence: The closed study used Windows and bounded cases; general task quality and native macOS operation are not established.
tests.assertion: Exercise varied independent cases and actual native service/duty behavior needed by the proposed claim.
tests.controls: Platform-specific lifecycle and task-outcome checks when those claims enter scope.
tests.action: Raise to required acceptance before claiming that platform/domain; never infer failure or success merely from missing evidence.

beforeOpen: Implement and demonstrate applicable positive/negative controls.
Declare exact goal, allowed paths, case versions, component constraints, comparison/missing-score policy and model/budget.
Commit independent gate cases and keep them outside optimizer inputs.
Freeze a new study; do not change closed-study receipts, scorer, weights or consumed attempts.
limitations: This is an operator plan, not a schema consumed automatically by study.py.
No new outcome measurements, model-operator causal ranking or native platform certification are claimed.
New tests can reject old patches independently without rewriting their original native scores.
